name: Ban Dung Credit Union Half Marathon 2026
short_description: Ban Dung Credit Union Half Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 11 October 2026 at Thung Si Mueang Ground in Ban Dung, Udon Thani, over 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: Ban Dung Credit Union Half Marathon 2026 is organised by TK SPORT at Thung Si Mueang Ground in Ban Dung district, Udon Thani, with entries on ThaiPhotoRun. It offers 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races, and every runner receives a medal and shirt. Overall trophies are awarded for men and women at each distance, along with age-group, fancy-dress and largest-club awards.

faqs.question: How much is the Ban Dung Credit Union Half Marathon entry fee?
faqs.answer: The registration page lists the 21 km at THB 650, the 10 km at THB 500 and the 5 km at THB 450. A VIP entry costs THB 1,000 with a collared shirt and medal, and a Super VIP entry costs THB 1,500 with a trophy added.

faqs.question: What awards are there at the Ban Dung Credit Union Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The top five men and women in each age group, from 19 and under to 70 and over, receive awards at each distance. There are also overall trophies for each distance, fancy-dress awards and awards for the clubs that bring the most runners.
